column3: the expression “UK retail investor” means a person  who is either one (or both) of the following: (i) not a professional client, as defined  in point (8) of Article 2(1) of Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 as it forms part  of UK domestic law, and as amended; or (ii) not a qualified investor, as defined in  paragraph 15 of Schedule 1 to The Public Offers and Admissions to Trading Regulations 2024,  as amended (the “POATRs”); and
